newsitem.title: UK: Meconic sees current sales up 14 percent.
newsitem.headline: Meconic sees current sales up 14 percent.

text.p: Meconic said sales excluding its Phoenix business had risen 14 percent in the four months ending August 14, fuelled by strong growth in demand for opiates.

In a statement to the annual meeting, chairman Terry James said that in the first two months of owning Phoenix performance was up to expectations, "strengthening our view that the acquisition will be earnings enhancing in the current year."
He reconfirmed predictions made at the annual results that further progress will be achieved in the current year.
Meconic is holding company for Macfarlan Smith, whose principal activity is the specialist manufacture of fine chemicals.
